details:
I've got a GPD WIN 4 2025 running Windows 11 and I'm having input issues when running VRChat in Desktop mode. I was told by VRChat Support to submit my issue as a feature request because there is no support for this handheld PC.

The touch screen doesn't pass events to VRChat, the hardware mouse clicks cannot be used in conjunction with the Tab key, the hardware mouse cannot move after using joystick controls unless I press a mouse button (causing something arbitrary to be clicked as the VRC cursor and the mouse cursor are not sharing the same coordinated), and sometimes I need to press and release Tab to enable mouse downs (which Avi Wars warns about when Alt+Tab-ing, but I don't have that issue on other devices and inputs).

If I play any other game or use a USB Hub with external mouse and keyboard, or play VRChat on any other PC, everything works perfectly and these issues are absent.

Currently, the only way VRChat input works is if I use Steam Input and joystick mode. As for moving the camera, right bumper won't work because it's reserved for moving held items, so I must use GPD's WinControls utility to map left backbutton to backtick key, then use AutoHotkey to map the backtick key to middlemouse.

Even if I don't use joystick mode on GPD WIN 4 2025, there are still issues. What a shame. A friend told me that his Steam Deck OLED perfectly supports touch controls right out of the box just like on VRChat Mobile.

Please implement a solution that accepts GPD WIN 4 2025 touch inputs as mouse inputs and hardware keyboard/mouse inputs as functionally as the ordinary USB keyboard/mouse inputs.

If need be, I could share my screen with a developer from VRChat Team to test input solutions as the GPD WIN 4 2025 costs around €1500.

Thank you for your support.
title: Input support for GPD WIN 4 2025
